request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: If the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 were used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often would it have to be verified in 2031?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P1Y", "text": "The IGEA-PRIM 5t bridge crane (position 13, Allegato A, Tabella A2; manufactured 2017) would need verification once a year in 2031. Outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, a mobile or transferable lifting appliance over 200 kg that is used regularly and was made more than 10 years earlier falls under Allegato VII, row 14 of D.Lgs. 81/2008, which requires annual verification. The crane was built in 2017, so by 2031 it is 14 years old. This classification assumes the crane counts as mobile or transferable; if it were treated as fixed, row 17 would apply instead, with biennial verification.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 14", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo regolare e anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6, ALLEGATO A, Tabella A2", "quote": "GRU A PONTE 2017- 13 IGEA -PRIM 5t 5000 2017 gen-17 SCORREVOLE 200086/CA"}, {"file": "DLGS71.md", "place": "art. 71, c. 11", "quote": "il datore di lavoro sottopone le attrezzature di lavoro riportate nell'allegato VII a verifiche periodiche volte a valutarne l'effettivo stato di conservazione e di efficienza ai fini di sicurezza, con la frequenza indicata nel medesimo allegato."}]}
